'''Endorian maple syrup''' was a type of [[Syrup/Legends|syrup]] that either tasted like or was an ingredient in the [[Iced Endorian maple donut]]s created by a [[Crisp-E-O donut droid]] and served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dex's Diner">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>
